originalEntry.title: What is a Transformer, a 12-minute explainer
originalEntry.author: dotey
originalEntry.description: A 12-minute explainer on Transformers and attention for high school students, one-shot on xhigh; Opus found free Edge TTS for narration and used Remotion with KaTeX.
originalEntry.description_zh: 给高中生讲 Transformer 和注意力机制的 12 分钟视频，xhigh 一次出片，配音用免费 Edge TTS。
originalEntry.prompt:
帮我用js制作一个视频，主题是：什么是 Transformer
要深入浅出，让高中生也能看得懂，不仅high level说的清楚，也要有细节，包括注意力机制，甚至一些数学概念

你可以用任何工具或者安装工具，可以联网检索

请给我惊喜
originalEntry.prompt_en:
Help me make a video with JS, on the topic: What is a Transformer
Explain it simply enough that high school students can follow. Make the high-level picture clear, but also include details, including the attention mechanism and even some math concepts

You can use any tool or install tools, and you can search the web

Surprise me
